name: working-state
description: Per-session working-state file for Claude Code: path and rules in the system prompt, restore after compaction and resume, staleness and pre-compaction nudges.

staleThreshold.title: Stale threshold
staleThreshold.description: Successful tool calls without a state-file change before a staleness nudge.

maxNudgesPerPrompt.title: Max staleness nudges per prompt
maxNudgesPerPrompt.description: Cap on staleness nudges between two user prompts.

compactAtTokens.title: Compaction point (tokens)
compactAtTokens.description: Context size where compaction is expected; 0 reads Claude Code's own threshold (autoCompactWindow).

preCompactMargin.title: Pre-compaction warning margin (tokens)
preCompactMargin.description: Warn this many tokens before the compaction point.
